# Beats

## B1 you
duration: 30
Wren trims the harbour lamp at dusk while her father watches from his chair.

## B2 need
duration: 30
The last wick gutters, and the boats are still out with a storm coming in.

## B3 go
duration: 30
Wren takes the rowing boat across the black bay alone.

## B4 search
duration: 30
On the far shore every chandler is shut except one, who wants more than coins.

## B5 find
duration: 30
The chandler has a full coil of wick, dry and new.

## B6 take
duration: 30
Wren gives up the boat for it and must walk home along the cliffs.

## B7 return
duration: 30
She climbs the lamp stair soaked, with the storm already on the water.

## B8 change
duration: 30
Wren lights the lamp herself and does not look back at her father for approval.
